positions.title: Full-time parenting
positions.description: Quality time with kid and our extended family in SE Asia.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Core contributor on the Campaigns team. We own the experience of creating, scheduling, and reporting on SMS and Email marketing campaigns, including those with AI powered subscriber specific delivery times and content

positions.title: Product Management Consultant
positions.description: Led an infrastructure engineering team to build and launch a Canonical Product Graph and Automated Product Match. Applied machine learning to merchant feeds to enrich the graph and power our RTB traffic acquisition business. Implemented improvements to the graph schema.

positions.title: Senior Product Manager
positions.description: Built out enterprise collaboration features for video makers in on our Apple award winning iOS app. Also brought to market an integration with Final Cut Pro X - a unique collaboration with the product team at Apple and launched on stage in Cupertino.

positions.title: Product Manager
positions.description: Led two development teams across SF and NY within the File Viewing/Previews area. Our systems serve hundreds of millions of daily views across over 300 filetypes, and we're Dropbox's most valuable surfaces for signups and paid account conversion.

positions.title: Head of Product
positions.description: Wore many hats as we built and released a Self Serve SAAS B2B product. Also launched several generations of custom hardware for measuring traffic in urban areas. We were acquired by Netgear in 2016.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: Built out an end to end demo including iOS SDK and demo app and website to help with fundraising and early hiring. Also recruited and interviewed engineers.

positions.title: Product Manager
positions.description: Led our Enterprise Video Ad Server, DFP (Doubleclick for Publishers) Video, providing product strategy and alignment for a large global development team sales team, and services team. Oversaw the successful build out and launch of advanced ad waterfall functionality and live video ad insertion optimizations.

positions.title: Product Manager
positions.description: Created the product discipline at a young travel commerce brand as we grew from 20 to 100. Launched a variety of projects including Site and Newsletter Personalization, Evergreen Inventory and GDS Integration, iPad and iPhone apps, Search, Collections, Partner Portals, 360 degree panoramic photos, and more.
